title: Bandwidth-normalized capacity proctor and differential burst tuner
author: Ava Park
description: Motivation: Production incidents during multi-tenant microbursts highlighted cases where GPU slot counts alone produced misleading free-capacity signals when network bandwidth or PCIe saturation constrained tail latency. This PR introduces a lightweight capacity proctor that normalizes available headroom by an observed bandwidth factor and a complementary differential burst tuner that enforces proportional burst admission across tenants based on recent delta-utilization. Design summary: 1) capacity_proctor: observes per-pool token spend, per-node network transmit/receive bytes, and an exponential moving estimate of IO pressure to compute an effective capacity multiplier (0.0-1.0) applied to reservations/burst budgets. 2) diff_burst_tuner: maintains a short-window delta-utilization ledger per-tenant, penalizes repeated burst wins with a decay multiplier, and seeds proportional burst allowances from the normalized capacity. 3) Safety: hard caps remain on absolute concurrent slots and a passive fallback route to the existing soft-reservation bank if network-normalized capacity drops below 20%. 4) Config: new autoscaler flags: --proctor-window-ms, --io-pressure-alpha, --delta-decay, --min-normalized-cap, and a per-tenant annotation allow-burst-weight to tweak proportional share. 5) Telemetry: exported metrics for proctor_normalized_capacity, tenant_delta_util_90, burst_win_penalty, and decision_trace_id for sampled decisions. Migration notes: deployable as a non-breaking feature behind the runtime flag autoscaler.enable_bandwidth_proctor=false by default; can be enabled cluster-by-cluster. Test plan: unit tests for proctor math and ledger decay, integration e2e that simulates node-level IO saturation and verifies throttling, canary rollout to one dedicated pool. Checklist: [x] RFC 2026 written and linked [x] unit tests added [x] e2e fixture and simulator added [x] metrics and dashboards sketched [x] docs/RFC updated [x] feature flagged and defaults off Related work: builds on prior work for soft-reservation bank and warm-pool smoothing, references ENG-4219 and RFC 2021. Impact: reduces tail latency regressions attributable to IO-bound nodes during tenant microbursts and provides a knob for operators to constrain burst admission when non-GPU resources are the limiting factor.

release_notes: - Adds bandwidth-normalized capacity proctor to reduce tail latency when IO/PCIe/network is the bottleneck. - Introduces differential burst tuner for proportional burst admission and decay penalties. - Metrics: proctor_normalized_capacity, tenant_delta_util_90, burst_win_penalty. - Feature flag autoscaler.enable_bandwidth_proctor=false by default.
comments: Leah Chen: Nice separation of concerns. Can you clarify how the proctor interacts with multi-pool routing? I want to ensure we don't double-count capacity when requests can failover to another pool.

Ava Park (author): Good point. The proctor is per-pool and we attach a decision_trace_id to requests that get rerouted; the router will re-evaluate normalized_capacity on the target pool and use the trace to attribute the original admission decision. Added a note in docs/observability/bandwidth_proctor_dashboard.md.
Miguel Soto: The decay multiplier looks aggressive in the unit tests; what's the rationale? Could we expose a safer default?
Ava Park (author): Adjusted default delta-decay from 0.75 to 0.9 and added a unit test for pathological repeated wins. Kept config tunable for ops to reduce conservatism.
Rahul Iyer: CI flaky on integration (timing). Please add a retry/backoff in the e2e fixture to reduce flakiness.
Ava Park (author): e2e fixture now includes a deterministic backoff loop and a marker file to assert saturation onset; re-ran integration and CI stabilized.
Leah Chen: Approved after responses and test stabilization.
SRE: Noted that dashboards should include per-node IO percentile. Added request to ops runbook to surface node IO alerts before autoscaler kicks in.
discussion_threads_summary: Reviewers requested clarifications on multi-pool routing, decay defaults, and e2e flakiness. Author updated defaults, improved tests and observability, and added documentation. Approval obtained from Leah Chen and SRE acked the runbook item.
notes: Feature gated rollout recommended: enable in canary pool, monitor proctor_normalized_capacity and tenant_delta_util_90 for 48 hours before cluster-wide enable.
performance_considerations: Adds O(1) per-request probe to decision path to read the latest normalized capacity; proctor state is sharded per-pool and updated on a 100ms timer to amortize work.
